One-time setup

This tutor chats with you about the problem above without ever revealing the answer. To use it, you need a free Google AI Studio key (takes about a minute):

  1. Go to aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with a personal Google account (a regular Gmail).
    Don't use your @scu.edu account — the university has this service turned off, and you'll see “Your account is managed by an organization…”
  2. Click Create API key and copy it.
  3. Paste it below.

The key is stored only in your browser (localStorage) and sent only to Google's Gemini API. It is never shared with this site. Keep the key to yourself — anyone who has it can spend your free quota.

Privacy. What you type here goes to Google and is handled under Google's terms, not the university's. On the free tier your conversations may be read by people at Google. Keep the chat to mathematics: no name, student ID, email, phone, or address; nothing about a classmate; nothing sensitive. Check screenshots before you send them — they often carry your name.

How is the tutor doing?

This goes to your instructor, not to Google and not into the chat. It is anonymous, and it has nothing to do with your grade.

Sent either way: which assignment and problem you were on, how many hints you had used, and your screen size. Never your name and never your API key. Please don't type personal information in the box above.
